rules.why: Rounded corners match the warm reading tone. Sharp corners feel technical next to long text.

rules.situation: An option in a menu or list
rules.why: The option corner nests inside the menu corner. Soft, even curves keep the warm tone.

rules.situation: Corners of cards, menus and dialogs
rules.why: Softer corners on cards and menus feel warm, like good paper.
Pills sit softly next to text.
